.bullet-family/.purpose: gitignored local output of the family toolchain lane; no committed source lives here, so the canonical required lane is the proof for the tree it reports on

.config/.purpose: nextest profiles and JUnit destinations used by the disjoint fast and contract partitions

.github/.purpose: actionlint, zizmor, and workflow policy prove hosted jobs match local scripts and converge fail closed

.gitignore.purpose: ignored diagnostic-output policy and workflow/source meta-controls

.ci-artifacts/.purpose: ignored unsigned CI observations and sanitized reports; the producing lane regenerates them

.jankurai/.purpose: gitignored audit lane output; the audit lane regenerates it from the pinned local auditor

AGENTS.md.purpose: agent entrypoint; the fast lane proves the commands it names

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: release language must stay evidence-backed and honestly blocked; the audit lane checks it

Justfile.purpose: command surface and source-before-fetch ordering; local parity checks every canonical recipe

README.md.purpose: documentation; the fast lane proves the commands it names

SPLIT.md.purpose: split-family contract; the required lane is the check it names

agent/.purpose: Jankurai metadata; the audit lane validates it

ci.toml.purpose: inactive forge-neutral Jeryu graph invoking the same local lanes; no runner is registered

crates/.purpose: prove Change/Candidate, capability API, journal, and proof roots

crates/bullet-git-workspace/.purpose: prove SafeGit isolation, private clone lifecycle, scope enforcement, and receipt-gated cleanup against real Git fixtures

crates/bullet-git-workspace/fuzz/.purpose: the required contract sub-step replays the six exact corpus outcomes; lint checks the standalone manifest with fmt and strict Clippy, and security audits its independent lock under deny.toml

crates/bullet-gitd/.purpose: prove unavailable authority prevents production mutation, private permits bind exact calls, durable replay fails closed, and stdio frames remain bounded

deny.toml.purpose: cargo-deny ban policy; the security lane is the check that reads it

docs/.purpose: architecture, testing, and release contracts; relative links, rustdoc, and doctests fail closed

docs/architecture.md.purpose: daemon trust-boundary contract checked with the required implementation proof

mutants.toml.purpose: prove the mutation examine list is pinned; this command is not a mutation-score receipt

ops/.purpose: atomic lane implementations, meta-guards, source admission, and sequential local convergence

ops/ci/mutants.sh.purpose: prove the L-16a baseline helper is executable and structurally closed

rust-toolchain.toml.purpose: pinned Rust toolchain; the required lane builds and lints with it

scripts/ci-doctor.sh.purpose: fail-closed admission of the pinned local tools used by the deterministic fast lane

scripts/ci-local.sh.purpose: canonical local lane dispatcher exercised by the required lane

scripts/ci-observation.sh.purpose: emit and validate unsigned bullet.ci-observation.v1 diagnostics without timestamps or raw logs

tools/.purpose: canonical Jankurai lane adapters; they delegate to the exact ops/ci lane script they name
